summary: IM Cannabis Corp. filed a Form 6-K reporting a definitive share purchase agreement dated August 16, 2026, to sell 100% of IMC Holdings (European assets) to Slil.com Holding Ltd. Consideration includes a C$3,000,000 advance payment and assumption of liabilities up to C$9,400,000, with no securities issued. Closing conditions include a pre-closing reorganization, tax certificate, and consents; termination possible if not closed by September 30, 2026. The sale is expected to improve equity by C$3.0 million and streamline operations. Watch for regulatory approvals and closing timing.
